headline: Kshitij Polyline Limited Rights Issue at ₹3.17 per share
sum: Kshitij Polyline announced a rights issue of equity shares in the ratio 2:5 at ₹3.17 per share, approved by the board on 13 August 2026.
implication: Rights issues at this scale and price point typically flag micro-cap equity raises; the 2:5 ratio suggests moderate dilution and a working capital or capex funding round rather than transformational capital raise.
detail: The Board of Directors of Kshitij Polyline Limited approved the issuance of equity shares on a rights basis, offering shareholders the opportunity to subscribe in the ratio of 2 new equity shares for every 5 existing shares held. The issue price of ₹3.17 per share was set by the board. The announcement was formally filed with the NSE on 13 August 2026. No stated consideration quantum or regulatory approval status was disclosed in the initial announcement.
